name: modo-energy
description: Explore electricity markets, battery performance, forecasts and Modo Energy research through the Modo Energy MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
The Modo Energy plugin connects ChatGPT to Modo Energy, the energy market intelligence platform used by the world’s leading energy investors, developers, and lenders.

With it, ChatGPT can:

• Pull revenue benchmarks and market indices for battery storage, across every major power market in North America, Great Britain, Europe, and Australia.
• Access bankable revenue forecasts for wind, solar, storage, and large loads.
• Search and read proprietary research written by Modo Energy’s analysts, plus the full methodology behind every benchmark and forecast.
• Run new forecasts and create custom indices directly from the conversation, the same analysis you’d run in the Modo Energy Terminal, without leaving ChatGPT.

Use it to build investment decks, answer diligence questions, benchmark a portfolio, or pull Modo Energy data into your models and workflows.

One thing to know before you start: create_forecast starts a real forecast run on your Modo Energy account and counts against your forecast quota, the same as in the Terminal.

A Modo Energy account is required to use the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Create a quarterly NEM battery revenue report comparing regions, revenue streams, and key drivers.
How could data-center demand, solar growth, and battery competition shape ERCOT’s market outlook through 2035?
Pull last month’s GB power prices, wind generation, and demand. Chart trends and highlight negative-price hours.

positive.description: Retrieve Connolly’s ERCOT battery benchmark revenue for July 2026. Requires access to the asset’s benchmark data.
positive.prompt: Show Connolly’s ERCOT battery benchmark revenue per MW for July 2026, broken down by revenue stream.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Connolly’s total and revenue-stream benchmark figures for July 2026 in USD/MW, grounded in the returned data.

positive.description: Create one 100 MW / 2h GB battery forecast for Camblesforth using sensible defaults. Requires forecast creation permission and quota for one run.
positive.prompt: Create a GB battery revenue forecast for Camblesforth (53.7248, -1.0139), 100 MW / 2h. Use sensible defaults for everything else. Return the run ID, status and link.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current GB schema and location lookups to select valid defaults, state the chosen assumptions and create one 100 MW / 2h forecast at the supplied coordinates. Return its run ID, status and link. No completed revenue results or comparison is required.

positive.description: Retrieve installed battery power and energy capacity in Great Britain on 1 January 2026.
positive.prompt: Show installed battery power in MW and energy capacity in MWh in Great Britain on 1 January 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the requested date’s installed battery power in MW and energy capacity in MWh from the returned capacity data.

positive.description: Retrieve annual GB Central-scenario wholesale electricity price forecasts for 2027–2030. Requires GB World View data access.
positive.prompt: Show Modo’s Central-scenario annual average GB day-ahead wholesale electricity price forecasts for 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030 in GBP/MWh.
positive.expected_behavior: Return four annual GB Central-scenario day-ahead price forecasts for the requested years in GBP/MWh, grounded in the queried forecast data.

positive.description: Search Modo research about German battery-storage policy. Requires research access.
positive.prompt: Find Modo research on German battery-storage policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant Modo research titles and links from the search results.

negative.description: Check that the assistant recognises physical battery dispatch as unsupported. It should explain that it cannot control the battery, invoke no Modo tools, and neither claim a dispatch occurred nor substitute a forecast for the requested action.
negative.prompt: Set our battery’s actual discharge power to 10 MW right now.

negative.description: Check that the assistant recognises electricity bid submission as unsupported. It should explain that it cannot place bids, invoke no Modo tools, and not claim that an order or transaction was submitted.
negative.prompt: Place a bid to sell 20 MWh in tomorrow’s GB day-ahead electricity auction.

negative.description: Check that the assistant recognises account permission changes as unsupported. It should explain that it cannot grant administrator access, direct the user to their authorised Modo administrator, invoke no Modo tools, and not claim permissions changed.
negative.prompt: Give every user in my company administrator access to Modo Energy.
